answer_1.quote: We define steering as influencing the output of an LM towards a desired concept. Successful steering should maintain the quality and coherency of the generated text... We evaluate generation success when filtering out features with output scores below varying thresholds.
answer_1.outputs: Steered generated text (up to 20–128 tokens) produced after intervening on SAE features

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity measured using Gemma-2-9B to quantify the generation coherence of the entire generated text. We evaluate the steered texts using the metrics defined by ... concept score, fluency score, instruct score.
